snippet.title: Beek: Familiar Spirit Remastered - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3586520/Beek_Familiar_Spirit__Remastered

A new version of Beek, remastered from the ground up for modern devices. Releases April 17th 2025 on Steam— free update on the App Store, Google Play, and itch.io!

Featuring a completely new English translation, new gameplay mechanics, new user interface, and more!

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beek-familiar-spirit/id1477804219
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.orangejuicedogshanghai.beek
Itch.io: https://studioklondike.itch.io/beek
